description: A script that generates API documentation pages with endpoint tables by processing OpenAPI spec and sidebar data, updating MDX files for API tags.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Converts text into a URL-friendly slug.

methods.name: buildSlugMap
methods.description: Builds a map from sidebar labels to document slugs by reading the sidebar.js file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads the OpenAPI spec, builds endpoint mappings, and updates MDX tag files with endpoint tables.
